records.issue_text: app/controllers/topics_controller.rb:98 — unsubscribe changes notification settings through a GET request without CSRF protection, allowing an external site to unsubscribe an authenticated user without consent.
records.rationale: The diff shows a new `unsubscribe` action in topics_controller.rb that modifies TopicUser notification_level via a GET request (line 98+). The route is defined as `get "t/:slug/:topic_id/unsubscribe"` in routes.rb.
